name: raci-matrix
title: RACI matrix
description: Who does what on a project: tasks down, people across, an R, A, C or I in each cell, and a check that every task has exactly one accountable person.
docs: Give it `tasks`, `people` and a `value` map where `value[taskId][personId]` is R, A, C or I. Control it with `value` and `onValueChange` (which also receives what changed), or let it keep its own state from `defaultValue`. It never forces exactly one accountable person: a row with none or with two is flagged in words and counted above the table, and the decision stays yours. Tasks that share a `group` fold under a heading, and a folded group still marks a task that needs attention. From the keyboard, arrow keys move between cells, R, A, C and I set a role, plus and minus step through the roles and Backspace clears one. `readOnly` draws plain letters for an approval screen or a report.
